НИКТЕЛ — российская ИТ\u2011компания, сп: NIKTEL is a Russian IT company specializing in building, modernizing and maintaining enterprise IT infrastructure.
Мы\u00A0помогаем организациям выстраиват: We help organizations build a reliable and secure IT environment that keeps the business running smoothly, protects corporate data and enables digital services to grow effectively.
Основные направления нашей деятельности: Our core areas are the design and construction of corporate IT infrastructure, system integration, information security, implementation and support of software and hardware solutions, and business process automation.
Проектирование и\u00A0модернизация серве: Design and modernization of enterprise server, network and computing infrastructure.
Построение локальных и\u00A0распределенн: Building local and distributed computer networks and setting up secure connectivity between offices and geographically distributed sites.
Внедрение решений для\u00A0защиты сетево: Deploying solutions to protect network infrastructure, information systems and corporate data, including next-generation firewalls, intrusion prevention systems and access control tools.
Создание и\u00A0модернизация виртуальных: Building and modernizing virtual environments, server platforms and data storage systems.
Подбор, тестирование и\u00A0внедрение ро: Selection, testing and deployment of Russian software and hardware solutions in line with customer needs and current regulatory requirements.
Внедрение решений, позволяющих сократить: Implementing solutions that reduce manual work and improve process transparency and team efficiency.
Поддержка ИТ\u2011инфраструктуры, диагно: IT infrastructure support, troubleshooting, modernization of existing systems and advisory support for the customer's IT staff.
Мы\u00A0рассматриваем ИТ не\u00A0как отд: We see IT not as a set of separate hardware and software products, but as a single technology system directly tied to business goals.
При реализации проектов специалисты НИКТ: When delivering projects, NIKTEL specialists take into account the customer's existing infrastructure, information security requirements, scalability prospects and operational specifics. This approach allows us to create solutions that remain reliable and manageable throughout their entire life cycle.
